description: Parliament of Sri Lanka - Summoning the Parliament to meet on 25.05.2016
categorisation: The gazette content is a notification by the Speaker of Parliament convening a session of Parliament on a specific date and time. This directly relates to the functioning and scheduling of the parliamentary process, which falls under electoral and parliamentary procedural matters. It does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories, making it best classified under Elections Gazettes (Type 7) for parliamentary convening.
